dataset: City of Toronto Open Data — Building Permits Active + Cleared
purpose: Technical false-negative backtest only. These permit-positive public records are not market-validation E3 evidence, do not measure upstream permit uncertainty, and are not a demand or SAM denominator.
privacy_note: Civic addresses, postal codes, applicants, owners, contractors, emails and phone numbers are intentionally omitted. Permit numbers, issue dates and paraphrased/sanitized scopes remain for reproducibility against the official City dataset.
curation_rule: Start from the first 60 deterministic chronological low-rise residential BLD candidates produced by the sampler. Skip New Building work because the current commercial wedge is renovation/preflight. When two rows explicitly describe the same related project, keep only the first candidate. Accept candidates in chronological order until 20 remain. Map only facts directly supported by City WORK/DESCRIPTION text: explicit addition -> addition + floor_area_increase; explicit dwelling-unit creation/conversion/combination -> dwelling_change + dwelling_unit_change; explicit load-bearing/beam/structural work -> structural_change (and modifies_walls only when a wall is explicit); explicit plumbing work -> plumbing_change. Where decisive facts are not explicit, keep a sparse family/literal action instead of inferring permit triggers.
